title: NOT THE SAME QUALITY AS LAST PURCHASE
text:
NOT THE SAME QUALITY AS LAST PURCHASE. I purchased these pillows one year ago. They arrived poofy & full. Soft, where your head squishes in, but yet holds its shape with some firmness. Truly have been my favorite pillow.
After one year they held up so well, without going flat I wanted to buy them again for my sons new bed. When I saw there were 40% off I was excited. When I unboxed them I don’t recall the last time them arriving rolled up right, deflated wrapped in plastic. I’m certain they didn’t arrive like this.
I compared them to the other ones, and the difference is clear. They look identical. Same fabric on the outside. Same tags and stated contents, but they are not the same. The new ones are poofy, but sink in almost all the way with very little support.
I would have returned them, but with the low price I’ll keep them as guest pillows.
